summary: Container notify-and-teardown sequence. Switches the container vtable to off_59E60C, then walks the nine child pointers at this+0x10..0x30; for each non-null child it dispatches the child's virtual method with argument 1 (argument 3 for the child at this+0x20). Finally switches the container vtable to off_59E634 and returns the last dispatch result. Called by ConditionalFreeByFlag (00408500).
